adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably changes webhook-related payload expectations from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (e.g., `apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts` updated to expect `[]`). Multiple event builders now set `destinationCalendar` to an empty array when no selection exists (e.g., `bookingReminder.ts` and `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts` use `selectedDestinationCalendar ? [selectedDestinationCalendar] : []`). While the diff doesn’t prove downstream breakage, it does show an externally-visible shape/semantic change (null vs empty array) and even inconsistency (some places still set `null`, e.g. `handleNewBooking.ts`), so the compatibility concern is grounded and actionable.
